tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand intent: filled buttons (`bg-primary`), links, focus ring of primary controls, selection. Holds 4.5:1 as text on `background` and `surface` in every theme.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `primary` fill (`hover:bg-primary-hover`); the recipe picks it up because the sibling key exists.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a `primary` fill (`active:bg-primary-active`).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill. Alias of `surface` (`$surface` in theme.json); at least 5.9:1 on `primary` in every theme.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Second intent for buttons and highlights. As small text it misses 4.5:1 on `background` in Light (4.27:1) and Forest (3.22:1; 3.62:1 on `surface`): use it for fills, 24px+ text or with `foreground` labels there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of `secondary` (`$secondary` in theme.json) for decorative emphasis that should follow the secondary hue.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: confirmations, the live dot, the lock icon on secure URLs. Pair with a word or icon. As small text it misses 4.5:1 in Forest (3.59:1 on `background`) and Sunset (4.40:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. Pair with a word or icon: it differs from `success` in hue more than lightness.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page ground: warm paper in Light. Outline buttons fill with it, and filled intents without an `on-*` sibling use it as their text colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards on `background`; also the ink of `primary-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text (`<Text>` defaults to it) and icons on `background` and `surface`; above 14:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, metadata, the `$` prompt. Misses 4.5:1 on `background` in Forest (4.19:1) and Sunset (4.28:1): keep it to 14px+ there or move it onto `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (`border-line`, `divide-line`). The source declares `color-mix(in srgb, var(--sg-color-foreground) 8%, transparent)`; these are that mix resolved per theme (`foreground` at 8% alpha). Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

styles.name: display-56-serif
styles.sample: A design system from one JSON.
styles.usage: Chapter and page headlines, set in `font-serif`; italicise one word for emphasis.

styles.name: text-20-semibold
styles.usage: Card titles and sub-headings; also the label size of a `size="lg"` button.

styles.name: text-16-medium
styles.usage: The default: `<Text>` without `type`, and every `sm`/`md` button label.

styles.name: text-14-regular
styles.usage: Body copy in dense UI, descriptions, table cells.

styles.name: text-12-mono
styles.usage: Code, token names, file paths, eyebrow labels; set in `font-mono`.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a button's icon and label (`gap-1.5`).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a `sm` button (`px-2.5`).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a `md` button (`px-3.5`).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a `lg` button (`px-5`).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a `sm` button (`h-7`).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of a `md` button, the default (`h-9`).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a `lg` button (`h-11`); also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline chips, code spans, small tiles (`rounded-sm`).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: the button preset's radius (`rounded-md`).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, preview frames (`rounded-lg`).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, eyebrow badges, status dots (`rounded-pill`).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and inputs on `background`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the large preview frame.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Default hairline (`border-thin`), in `line` or an intent colour.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Selected or emphasised outlines (`border-thick`).

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Light frosting behind sticky bars (`backdrop-blur-sm`).

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Overlays and floating toolbars (`backdrop-blur-md`).

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Modal scrims (`backdrop-blur-lg`).

tokens.name: opacity-10
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: `bg-primary/10` behind soft buttons and hovered ghost buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-20
tokens.usage: Stronger tints and selected rows (`bg-<color>/20`).

tokens.name: opacity-50
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (`disabled:opacity-50`) and half-strength text (`text-foreground/50`).

tokens.name: opacity-80
tokens.usage: Near-solid overlays (`bg-background/80` under a blur).

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: First responsive step (`md:`); the generator emits `md:` coverage by default.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Second responsive step (`lg:`); the last one with default coverage.
